name: Antigravity Agent API
summary: Spin up a hosted coding agent with its own Linux sandbox in one API call. It runs code, browses, and edits files on Gemini 3.8 Flash. New Files and Credentials APIs connect it to your data and MCP servers. Sandbox compute is free in preview.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
summary: Design a voice by describing it, pick from 2,000-plus stock voices, or clone one from 30 seconds of audio across 100-plus languages. A cheaper Flash-Lite TTS ships alongside, both live now in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

name: CLM-8B
summary: Make agents choose tools and next actions without paying a language model to write prose. The Apache-2.0 weights, code, fine-tuning guide, TypeSafe-compatible API, and local playground are available now, with reusable action caching for faster decisions.

name: Gemini Connected Apps
summary: Run projects, design assets, and build websites from Gemini by connecting Airtable, Linear, Adobe, Squarespace, Webflow, and more. The integrations are rolling out now and work inside chat with an @ mention or plain-language request.

name: Claude Opus 5.5
summary: Get near-Fable coding and agent quality for about 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads. API pricing is $4 in and $20 out per million tokens, with cheaper cache reads and a faster 2x-priced mode.

name: GPT-6 Sol + Luna
summary: Build on the new GPT-6 pair at half the old price: Sol handles coding and agent work at $2 in and $10 out per million tokens, and Luna covers high-volume tasks at $0.10 and $0.50. Both are live in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

name: MiMo-V2.6 Pro + Flash
summary: Download open weights that top the open-weight intelligence leaderboards: Pro is a trillion-parameter omnimodal reasoner, Flash is the small MIT-licensed sibling. Xiaomi also published 7,000-plus reinforcement-learning environments and the RL code on Hugging Face.

name: Bonsai 2 27B
summary: Run a 27B reasoning, coding, and vision model on a laptop: ternary weights squeeze it to 5.9GB while keeping 98% of full-precision scores. It has 262K context, Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face, and MLX builds for Mac and iPhone plus CUDA.
